clips.caption:
Four friends. One gloomy day. Nobody said a word.

Kevin Trudeau tells a story from Ojai, California. It was a rainy, dreary day and everyone was in a blah mood. He suggested a drive to Ventura for donuts.

On the way there nobody spoke. A few minutes after they started eating on the drive home, they were singing, dancing and laughing.

Kevin jokes that it was the miracle of the sugar drug.

What small thing lifts your mood on a gloomy day?
